name: facebookresearch_humenv/humenv/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_humenv/humenv/env.py.create_HumEnv: create a HumEnv humanoid simulation environment with a reward task, XML model, and state init mode
facebookresearch_humenv/humenv/env.py.reset_HumEnv: reset the HumEnv environment to a t-pose, fall, or MoCap-based initial state
facebookresearch_humenv/humenv/env.py.step_HumEnv: step the HumEnv environment forward with an action and return observation, reward, and termination
facebookresearch_humenv/humenv/env.py.render_HumEnv: render the HumEnv simulation as an RGB array from the configured camera angle
facebookresearch_humenv/humenv/env.py.compute_humanoid_self_obs_v2: compute a proprioceptive observation dictionary with heading-invariant local body positions, rotations, and velocities

facebookresearch_humenv/humenv/reset.py.reset_human_to_tpose: reset a MuJoCo human model to a standing T-pose with zero velocity
facebookresearch_humenv/humenv/reset.py.reset_human_to_fall: reset a MuJoCo human model to a randomized falling state with random orientation and actions
facebookresearch_humenv/humenv/reset.py.reset_human_default_or_fall: reset a MuJoCo human model to either T-pose or a falling state based on a probability
facebookresearch_humenv/humenv/reset.py.convert_euler_to_quaternion: convert Euler angles to a quaternion using MuJoCo's mju_euler2Quat utility function
facebookresearch_humenv/humenv/reset.py.simulate_random_actions: simulate random control actions on a MuJoCo model for a specified number of integration steps

facebookresearch_humenv/humenv/rewards.p.create_LocomotionReward: create a LocomotionReward instance to compute humanoid locomotion rewards with configurable speed and angle
facebookresearch_humenv/humenv/rewards.p.create_JumpReward: create a JumpReward instance to compute rewards for humanoid jumping to a target height
facebookresearch_humenv/humenv/rewards.p.create_HeadstandReward: create a HeadstandReward instance to compute rewards for maintaining a headstand pose
facebookresearch_humenv/humenv/rewards.p.create_RotationReward: create a RotationReward instance to compute rewards for rotating around a specified axis at target velocity
facebookresearch_humenv/humenv/rewards.p.create_ArmsReward: create an ArmsReward instance to compute rewards for raising arms to specified left and right poses

facebookresearch_humenv/humenv/utils.py.convert_quaternion_wxyz_to_xyzw: convert a numpy quaternion array from wxyz format to xyzw format using wxyz_to_xyzw
facebookresearch_humenv/humenv/utils.py.rotate_vector_by_quaternion: rotate a 3D vector by a quaternion using quat_rotate to apply the rotation
facebookresearch_humenv/humenv/utils.py.compute_heading_from_quaternion: compute the heading angle in radians from a quaternion using calc_heading
facebookresearch_humenv/humenv/utils.py.multiply_two_quaternions: multiply two quaternion arrays together using quat_mul to compose rotations
facebookresearch_humenv/humenv/utils.py.convert_quaternion_to_exponential_map: convert a normalized quaternion to an exponential map representation using quat_to_exp_map
